_comment: Written by the freeze round-trip. `digest` is over the exported markdown exactly as committed — scripts/freeze-stamp-check.mjs re-derives it, so an edit to the frozen file after the freeze is a finding, not a silent change.
_refreeze_note: rc.46 re-freeze. The residual-risk verdict in the exported markdown read "Not yet.", which passed the D6 verdict check only because the pattern matched the "no" inside "Not" — a defect fixed this release by anchoring it to word boundaries. Correcting the example meant changing frozen bytes, and this gate caught it, which is the gate doing its job: a frozen artifact edited in place changes what a D-gate saw without going back through the surface that produced it. The stamp is therefore re-issued over the corrected export rather than the digest being quietly patched to match.
